evidence.irr: 『approximately 75% of our total spending on components was sourced from approximately 40 suppliers, many of which are the single source』=部品側は単一供給依存だが、需要側では代替(手動変速機・EV直駆動)が存在しOEM統合の移行摩擦は高いが唯一供給ではない=70(高摩擦移行困難)
evidence.rep: 『world's first fully automatic transmission... over 75 years ago』+『installed base of vehicles... continues to grow』+製造85%集中(プロセス知)=複製極困難だが、特許はGM保有・順次失効しEVで技術リセットの余地=80(極困難)
evidence.dur: 『The aftermarket provides us with a relatively stable source of revenues as the installed base of vehicles and equipment utilizing our solutions continues to grow』=据付ベース+アフター+OEM統合のスイッチングコストが持続性の主因=75
evidence.erosion: 『accelerated adoption of electric vehicles... may result in a decline in our market share』『competitors... able to develop, validate and release new technologies more quickly than we do, could also lead to... a decline in our market share』=EV起点のシェア侵食が顕在化しつつあるが未実現=emerging
